meta.title: Initial setup
meta.description: Set up your account in a few steps.

title: Set up your account
subtitle: We will guide you through your first steps.

skip.title: Skip setup
skip.message: You can complete these steps later from Settings. Do you want to skip the walkthrough?

welcome.title: Welcome aboard!
welcome.intro: In less than a minute we will show you how to start organizing your finances.
welcome.languageHint: You can change it later from Settings.

account.title: Create your first account
account.subtitle: An account represents the money you hold in a bank, in cash or in savings.
account.balanceHint: Enter the balance you are starting with. It can be 0.
account.continueHint: Continue to discover your dashboard modules.
account.existingNote: You already have accounts. You can continue or create a new one.

modules.title: Explore the modules
modules.subtitle: These are the modules available in your panel. You can reach them from the sidebar.
modules.hint: There is nothing else to configure for now.

finish.title: All set!
finish.subtitle: Your account is configured. Here is a summary of what you did.
